subject: The one person who needs this app
preview_text: You know who it is. 60 days in, you've optimized your sound. Now share it.
body_paragraphs: Sixty days ago, you downloaded Loud EQ. You've optimized your commute, your podcasts, your late-night audiobooks. You know the feeling: crisp dialogue, no strain, loud without distortion. That's not luck. It's the app working.

But there's someone in your life who still cranks their phone to 100% and misses every word. Your partner on road trips. Your parent who watches videos on a quiet speaker. Your friend who drives with the windows down and can't hear a podcast. You know exactly who I mean.
Open Loud EQ. Tap the Share button. Send them your Optimized profile. They'll hear the difference in one tap. No setup. No guesswork. You've already done the calibration for them.
Send it now. One person, one share. That's it. P.S. When they sign up, you both unlock a 7-day Premium trial. No strings. Just louder, clearer sound for the people you care about.
